description: Search the ~1,072-recipe USDA MyPlate Kitchen collection (public domain). Filter by free-text query, food group, dish category, max calories and minimum rating. Returns recipe cards with slug, calories, food groups, image and links. Use get_recipe with a slug for the full recipe.

food_group.description: Food-group key: fruits, vegetables, grains, protein-foods, or dairy.

max_calories.description: Only recipes at or below this calorie count per serving.

q.description: Free-text search over recipe name + description, e.g. "black bean".

name: search_recipes
title: Search MyPlate Kitchen recipes
